title: Sonoran Desert Sunset: Guided Nature Walk & Cactus Tasting Tour
includes: Tour with a local guide/ botanist
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Your tour includes everything: Tour, cactus candy, bottled water & snacks. Minutes from Downtown Scottsdale, Phoenix & Tempe. 

Slow down, breathe deeply, & experience a Sonoran Desert sunset in a whole new way. This 1.5 hr walking tour combines captivating stories, Western and Native history, nature connection, cactus candy tasting & more! 

This experience is designed for anyone seeking a deeper connection with the beauty of the Sonoran Desert—no hiking expertise required. Come walk, breathe, reconnect, and let the Sonoran Desert become part of your Arizona journey. 

Professional guides, safe trails, restrooms. 

 * Nature Walk 
* Wildlife Watching 
* Western & Native History 
* Gemstones 
* Cactus Candy Tasting 

Contact Walk The Desert for private or corporate bookings. 

This tour was originally hosted at Desert Botanical Garden, but has now expanded to the Papago Butte Mountains, where the experience has grown into a deeper and more immersive connection with the Sonoran Desert.
